newsitem.title: MONACO: SOCCER-ANDERSON EXTENDS CONTRACT AT MONACO TO 2001.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ANDERSON EXTENDS CONTRACT AT MONACO TO 2001.

text.p: Brazilian striker Sonny Anderson has pledged himself to French first division leaders Monaco until the year 2001, squashing any hopes Paris St Germain had of snatching him up for next season.

Anderson, top scorer in the French first division last season with 21 goals and now on 15 with nine games to go this term, signed a two-year extension on Monday to his current contract with the club from the principality.
Treating it as a formality, the 26-year-old Anderson said: "I've always said that if one day I left the decision would come from the club... I'm happy here. I've never wanted to leave."
The former Vasco da Gama and Guarani forward has scored 63 goals in 102 French first division games since he joined Marseille from Servette Geneva in 1993. He has been at Monaco since 1994.
